OfflineVisibilityInfo: When the “Hide Online Status” feature is enabled, your online status will not be completely hidden. Instead, it reduces how often you appear as online. You may still appear online when interacting with the app, such as sending messages, reacting to them, or reading messages. Your status will return to offline after about 30–60 seconds. For the best result, it is recommended to enable all Ghost Mode options.

HideChatsInfo:
Only the chats you add to “Chats to manage” can ever be hidden; every other chat always stays visible and is never touched.

Under “Show while hiding” you tick the managed chats that stay visible. While hiding is on, the managed chats you did not tick are hidden; turning hiding off shows all of them again.

Hidden chats disappear from every folder, the archive, contacts, search (recent searches, suggestions and results), share and forward lists, stories and unread counters, and messages forwarded from them are hidden in other chats too. They keep receiving messages. Secret chats follow their user, and the lists are saved separately for each account.
HideChatsPickerHintManaged: Pick the chats this feature is allowed to hide. Every other chat always stays visible.
HideChatsPickerHintVisible: Pick which of the managed chats stay visible while hiding is on. The rest of them are hidden.
